Do not copy the style knight's western plate armor, blue heraldry, pose props, or winged lion. Reference 2 gives THIS clan's heraldry and palette only. Adapt its symbol simply and accurately on a small cloth badge. Subject: A calm adult Norse clan musician-guard of Clan Grünklang in Klangheim, muted forest green and ochre, two crossed wooden flutes with three leaves embroidered on the tunic. Unhelmeted, tied brown hair, green wool cap hanging from belt; padded coat and small mail collar, calf wraps and boots. Holds ONE wooden transverse flute in both hands at waist height, short sheathed seax. No shield. A house representative, not a named character. Calm upright three-quarter stance, entire figure including headgear, weapon tips and boots with generous clear margins. Real transparent PNG background, alpha zero outside the figure and in open gaps. No ground, external shadow, halo, glow, backdrop, text, frame, photorealism, thick comic ink, CGI, huge decorative spikes or dramatic effects. This is a representative house illustration, no new named person.
